note: Free public Solana mainnet-beta RPC, verified with getGenesisHash against the mainnet genesis. Keyless public Solana RPC is scarce, so this list is shorter than the EVM ones; a user-supplied provider key added through the endpoint settings is the recommended upgrade. The websocket rows carry the accountSubscribe registrations on each owner and its associated token accounts that wake a sync pass the moment a watched balance moves, and each was verified by subscribing and receiving a push. PublicNode without a personal token refuses getTokenAccountsByOwner and any batch with more than one getTransaction, and never answers logsSubscribe, so the adapter reads token accounts by address and fetches transactions one per request.
